thesis: Web ecosystem governance is progressing across both technical standards bodies refining bot data collection practices and antitrust regulators structuring user choice in search discovery.

executive_shifts.headline: IETF Web Bot Auth WG Updates Draft on Responsible Crawling Standards
executive_shifts.summary: The IETF Web Bot Auth Working Group received an updated revision of the Internet-Draft 'Best Practices for Responsible Web Data Collection' (draft-farzdusa-webbot-datacollection-01), preventing expiration and continuing discussions on operational standards for automated web data collectors.

executive_shifts.headline: UK CMA Launches Consultation on Google Search User Choice Conduct Requirement
executive_shifts.summary: The UK Competition and Markets Authority initiated a consultation on 23 September 2026 regarding a proposed user choice conduct requirement for Google Search under the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024, building on earlier conduct requirements tied to Google's Strategic Market Status designation.

intelligence_read: Standardization and regulatory initiatives are targeting critical structural layers of the web. Within the IETF Web Bot Auth Working Group, an updated Internet-Draft renews operational standards for responsible data collectors. Concurrently, the UK Competition and Markets Authority is consulting on a user choice conduct requirement for Google's general search services under the DMCC Act 2024 framework.
